categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies test/functional/wallet_fast_rescan.py, which tests wallet descriptor keypool topups and fast rescan functionality.
categories.rationale: Improves wallet fast rescan test robustness to prevent false positives and verify descriptor keypool topups occur as expected. As noted in commit f217da5c59, earlier review observed a tendency for test code to defeat the purpose of the test by skipping topups, making explicit descriptor range assertions valuable.
